title: Malicious code in biatec-avm-gas-station (npm)
description: The biatec-avm-gas-station npm package versions 1.1.1 and 1.1.2 contain malicious code. Any system with this package installed or running is considered fully compromised, potentially allowing an attacker full control. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system is strongly advised. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components due to possible persistent backdoors or additional malware installed.
